built.label: fig:pipeline-status
built.note: Four stages numbered 1 to 4 as Chapter 1 numbers them. Every number is read by key from results/accord/VERIFIED_FACTS.json (keys: gold.base_rate_299, gold.n_total, exemplar.rule_1_2_pooled_exemplar_correct_rate_in_299.rate, exemplardirect.defect_rate, exemplar_recomputed.rule_1_2_pooled.wrong_rate, c120.g299.n, c120.g299.n_flagged, c120.g299.mcc, c120.g299.ceiling_mcc, rulehead.test_rule_type_macro_f1, decontam.aggregate.ensemble_auroc, decontam.aggregate.ensemble_ci95_hi, sizectl108.power_curves.primary_crossing_power_0_80); no withdrawn key is readable. Every number on the canvas prints to two decimals, except stage 1's three miss rates, which print to four as the captions do; full precision stays in this note and in the tables. Three chip encodings, distinct in greyscale and named in an on-canvas key: stage 1 not established (MIST fill, dashed GRAPHITE rim, hatched; miss rate 0, 0.4745, or 0.9315 by instrument); stages 2 and 3 reading unsupported (solid scarlet, the only scarlet on the canvas: MCC 0.0269 against a ceiling of 0.0780; the three credited architectural components fail a code audit); stage 4 bounded null (paper fill, solid rim: interval upper end 0.7034 under the 80 percent power floor 0.7466). The carrier rail is GRAPHITE, not scarlet: it records that stages 2 to 4 consumed the exemplar stage 1 selected, which is shared input, not a failed check. No plate; the stage column is sized from measured text widths so the spine takes about the left fifth of the canvas. No internal identifiers on the canvas.

built.label: fig:exemplar
built.note: Schematic; slots are abstract labels (M1 to M5, action classes written out as continuation and cessation) and carry no clinical text. Row 1, the exemplar selected by position, carries a 2.0 pt INK outline and a 'shown' tag; row 5, where the rule matched, keeps its SCARLET_WASH ground and a 'fired' tag. A vertical brace left of M1 to M5 states that the rule quantifies over the whole set. Colour round: nursing-note slots are AZURE_WASH and discharge-summary slots TANGERINE_TINT, grounds only under a neutral SLATE stroke (both were MIST; cobalt still means extraction elsewhere), 0.136 apart in relative luminance. No plate. The one-line deck prints the three instruments' miss rates, read from the register by key: exemplar.rule_1_2_pooled_exemplar_correct_rate_in_299.rate (one minus it, 0), exemplar_recomputed.rule_1_2_pooled.wrong_rate (0.4745), exemplardirect.defect_rate (0.9315). Gate note: tools/measure_ink.py holds this canvas to chroma 0.055; it measures 0.023, because the cobalt slot fills and strokes the floor was set against are removed by the critique and the only saturated element left is the cessation chip. The floor was not met by adding colour; it needs lowering by the gate owner.

built.label: fig:cohort-flow
sources: results/accord/source_summaries/phase1_summary.json, derived: has_both_roles 9820 minus valid_admissions_both_selected 9783; admissions holding both note roles for which no nursing note has a non-null chart time strictly before discharge
built.note: Path from the source database to the evaluated core, ten stages. Every count is read from results/accord/VERIFIED_FACTS.json by key (cohort.heart_failure.pre_los, cohort.heart_failure.post_los, cohort.heart_failure.removed, cohort_chain.has_both_roles, cohort_chain.valid_admissions_both_selected, cohort_chain.both_roles_not_selectable, extraction.medication_extraction.total_mentions, extraction.medication_extraction.classified_mentions, extraction.medication_extraction.unclassified_derived, extraction.temporal_prefilter.final_candidates, extraction.annotation_sample.total_sampled, c120.g299.n, c120.g299.n_positives, c120.g253.n, c120.g253.n_positives, overcallamb.n_ambiguous), and every right-hand count carries its unit. Every stub under the 'left the path' heading now states an exclusion, never a kept count (audit item 5): solid stubs are exclusions the register records as counts (11 with no positive length of stay, 37 with no nursing note before discharge, 131,347 unclassified mentions, 46 coded ambiguous). Dashed stubs are drops no file records as an exclusion, drawn as differences computed in code from two register counts: admissions after the length-of-stay filter minus admissions with both note types (3777); mentions with an action class minus candidates surviving the temporal prefilter (86,358, previously missing a box entirely); candidates minus the sample (1,678); the sample minus the annotated pairs (1). The ambiguous count is read from overcallamb.n_ambiguous, asserted equal to 299 minus 253 and cross-checked against the signal-check file. The core is drawn in the pharmacist's emerald rather than scarlet, which the set reserves for a failed check. Headline built from the register: of 1,978 candidates, 12 contradictions survive sampling and annotation.

The three public models carry no hue: llama3:8b INK, circle, solid; granite3.3:8b MUTE, square, dash (0,(4,2)); qwen3:8b SLATE, triangle, dot (0,(1,1.5)); dodged by -0.004, 0, +0.004 on x. ylim -0.012 to 0.32, xlim 0 to 0.27. The over-prediction wedge is FOG and the calibration diagonal is labelled in both panels. Gate note: tools/measure_ink.py holds this canvas to chroma 0.026 and it measures 0.000, because the critique removes every hue from it. built.label: fig:power
built.note: Built by fig_batch2.make_fig_power(). Keys: power.n_positives, power.n_negatives, power.alpha, power.power, sizectl108.power_curves.n_pos_slots, n_neg_slots, mde_analytic, primary_crossing_power_0_80, label_mix.crossings_at_power_0_80.mw_two_sided, label_mix.crossings_at_power_0_80.c98_rule. The Hanley and McNeil curve is recomputed and asserted equal to the register's analytic value. Analytic point hollow INK circle on the curve; Mann-Whitney 80 percent power point filled INK circle; registered decision rule INK diamond; 0.6 pt SLATE guide at 12 positives; labels right with leader lines; FOG below the curve, paper above; chance line labelled; ticks 10, 100, 1,000. AUROC printed to two decimals. Gate note: tools/measure_ink.py holds this canvas to coverage 0.53, set when both regions were filled; with the upper region bare paper as the critique asks it measures 0.19. Tinting the upper region to pass would be a band drawn for the tool, so it was not done; the floor needs lowering by the gate owner.

The identity is re-evaluated at every committed gate row and asserted equal to its committed ceiling. The four attaining squares are still checked but no longer drawn (the critique allowed labelling or dropping them; four labels did not fit without crossing a curve). Curves are named at their left ends in the enlarged panel, 12 of 299 and 12 of 253, from the register. The region above both ceilings is FOG and labelled not attainable on either basis: the identity defines it. Zoom box 0.6 pt SLATE on all sides (left panel limits widened slightly so no edge sits on a spine). Right panel y label 'Largest attainable MCC (enlarged)'. MCC to two decimals. The scope sentence (a thresholded decision, not a swept score) moved from the deck to the caption.
